description: A project's DISABLED-test debt, WITH ITS AGE. Walks the folder, finds every `it.skip`, `xit`, `@Ignore`, `@pytest.mark.skip` or `t.Skip`, and dates it with `git blame`. None of those cases appears in a coverage report, because as far as the runner is concerned they do not exist: this is the debt nobody measures and the one that lasts longest — disabled 'to fix later', and later never comes. Sorted oldest first, which is what makes it actionable.

folder.description: Root of the project (or subtree) to review.

maxFiles.description: Cap on how many test files to read.

name: test_debt
